sections.heading: Understanding pos system price components in India
paragraphs: A restaurant POS system price can include the software subscription, terminals, printers, setup, training and third-party services. The amount depends on the outlet count, devices and services in the quote.
Compare proposals for the same term and setup. Record the subscription, one-time charges, recurring fees, tax treatment and renewal terms separately so you can calculate the cost over three years.

callout.title: Published RestaBee subscription prices
callout.text: Checked 12 November 2026: one outlet costs ₹2,499 for 3 months, ₹4,299 for 6 months or ₹6,999 for 12 months. Multi-outlet subscriptions cost ₹5,999 per outlet per year, with a two-outlet minimum. Hardware, third-party services and custom work are quoted separately.

sections.heading: Compare software subscription terms
paragraphs: To compare a POS software price in India, use the same outlet count, contract length and feature scope. The figures below are RestaBee's published terms, checked on 12 November 2026.

rows.column4: Multiply the per-outlet amount by the number of outlets.

paragraphs_after: RestaBee's published subscription prices are the complete payable amounts; GST is not added separately. Hardware, third-party services and custom work are quoted separately. Check each supplier's current price and tax terms before comparing.

sections.heading: Hardware breakdown: terminals, printers and tablets
paragraphs: Hardware costs depend on the devices and installation quoted for your restaurant. List each item and confirm its model, price, warranty and setup requirements with the supplier.

checklist.detail: Record the device model, display, included accessories, warranty and installation. Ask the POS provider to confirm compatibility with the chosen device.
List the number of printers, paper width, connection type, cables and any setup charge. Confirm the software and printer route work together.
Count the devices needed for service. Test the POS on the selected model and include any case, stand or charging equipment in the quote.
Check the drawer model, connection, required cables and whether the supplier includes installation and configuration.

sections.heading: Setup, training and recurring charges
paragraphs: Ask each supplier to list one-time and recurring charges in the written quote. Confirm when each charge applies and whether it changes at renewal.

subsections.heading: 1. Onboarding and menu setup
paragraphs: Ask whether setup, menu entry, tax configuration and staff training are included. If they are charged separately, record the scope and amount.

subsections.heading: 2. Additional devices and outlets
paragraphs: List every workstation, kitchen screen, printer and outlet in the quote. Ask whether adding devices or locations changes the subscription and whether the charge recurs.

subsections.heading: 3. Payment and other third-party services
paragraphs: If the proposed setup uses an external payment provider or service, confirm who bills for it, how the fee is calculated and whether any separate hardware is required.

subsections.heading: 4. Messages and digital receipts
paragraphs: If your workflow sends digital bills or messages, ask whether a third-party service is involved. Record its unit price, billing party and renewal terms.

sections.heading: 3-Year Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) scenarios
paragraphs: Use the same outlet count, term, devices and services in each three-year estimate. This example applies RestaBee's published subscription prices checked on 12 November 2026 across three years. It holds today's rate constant for comparison; confirm renewal pricing before budgeting. Add the hardware, setup and third-party amounts from your own quotes.

sections.heading: How to evaluate vendor quotes objectively
paragraphs: Request an itemized quote for the same outlet count, device list and contract term from each supplier. Compare subscription renewals, setup, taxes, support, warranties, additional devices and third-party services. Write down the restaurant billing software price separately from hardware, setup and third-party charges.
Ask how you can retrieve your restaurant's sales, menu and customer data if you leave the service. Get the export format, process and any applicable fee in writing.

faqs.question: What is the average POS system price for a small restaurant in India?
faqs.answer: There is no single price that applies to every restaurant. Compare the subscription scope, device list, setup, recurring services and renewal terms. RestaBee's published prices are ₹2,499 for 3 months, ₹4,299 for 6 months or ₹6,999 for 12 months for one outlet; hardware is quoted separately.

faqs.question: Can I use an existing Android tablet or Windows laptop for my POS?
faqs.answer: Ask the POS provider to confirm compatibility with your specific tablet, computer, operating system and printer before including existing devices in your budget.

faqs.question: Are there free restaurant billing software options in India?
faqs.answer: Check the provider's current plan terms. Ask whether it limits bills, devices, outlets, reports, support or data export, and confirm what happens if you move to a paid plan.

faqs.question: Does POS software price include GST?
faqs.answer: Tax treatment varies by quote. RestaBee's published subscription amounts are the complete payable prices, with no GST added separately. Confirm the tax treatment of every other quote.
